mods.name: Solar Slayers
mods.description:
Quality-of-life features for slayers on SolarSkies: boss and miniboss highlights, a slayer progress HUD, pity meter, upgrade tracker and quest warnings. Unofficial.
Author: ItzNotNeptune

releases.notes:
Test build, 1.21.11 only.

## New
- **Fire Overlay (low fire).** Moves the flames on your screen down while you burn. Slider in `/slayer+` → World: 100% is normal, lower moves them down, 0% hides them. Default 50%.

Put `solarslayers-0.1.12+1.21.11.jar` in your mods folder in place of the old Solar Slayers jar. Needs [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.11.

Author: ItzNotNeptune

releases.notes:
Grave World Shade, Prism Laser outline, RNG drops and session stats. Everything since 0.1.8.

## New
- **Grave World Shade.** Darkens the bright blocks of world 1 (Grave Tyrant): sand, the sandstone family, birch wood, smooth and chiseled quartz, calcite and white wool. Only in that world, so the hub looks the same as before. Slider in `/slayer+` → World (default 40%, 0% turns it off).
- **Prism Laser Outline.** Hides the Prism Laser's rainbow particles (anyone's laser) and draws a thin hollow outline along the beam instead. On by default. In `/slayer+` → World you can turn it off, or switch the outline from a still rainbow to one colour.
- **RNG Drops.** A HUD panel counting `DROP!`, `RARE DROP!`, `VERY RARE DROP!` and `CRAZY RARE DROP!` this session, plus pity meter payouts. It lists each item you got, rarest first and coloured by rarity, and your last drop with its luck.
- **Session Stats.** A HUD panel with your active time, mob kills, boss kills and gen slots gained this session. The clock stops 3 minutes after your last kill and carries on with the next one.

Both HUD panels are on by default. Toggle them, or reset the session, in `/slayer+` → Slayer HUD; move them with Edit HUD.

## Downloads
| Your Minecraft version | File |
|---|---|
| 1.21.11 | `solarslayers-0.1.11+1.21.11.jar` |
| 1.21.9 or 1.21.10 | `solarslayers-0.1.11+1.21.9.jar` |
| 26.3 | `solarslayers-0.1.11+26.3.jar` (needs Java 25, like 26.3 itself) |

Replace the old Solar Slayers jar in your mods folder. Needs [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for the same Minecraft version.

Author: ItzNotNeptune

releases.notes:
Slayer Timer, pity improvements, Solar mob colours and Prismarine Shade. Everything since 0.1.3, now for all three Minecraft versions.

## New
- **Slayer Timer.** A new HUD panel showing how long the boss takes to spawn and to kill, your last run, bosses this session, **bosses per hour**, and your average and best run. Bosses/hr only changes when a boss dies, and breaks over 10 minutes don't drag it down. Toggle and reset it in `/slayer+` → Slayer HUD; move it with Edit HUD.
- **Pity in Bosses.** `/slayer+` → Slayer HUD → **Pity in Bosses** shows how many bosses are left until your pity drop (e.g. `6 bosses left`) instead of `100/250 (40%)`. It appears after your first kill with this version.
- **Saved pity XP.** With no pity item set, the Pity Meter panel shows how much XP you have saved (e.g. `66k XP saved`), updated after each kill. Setting a pity item clears it, since the saved XP goes into the item.
- **Solar Mob Highlight.** `/slayer+` → Blaze Slayer colours the normal Solar slayer mobs (blazes and zombified piglins, like Solar Blaze) in a colour you pick. Slayer world only; bosses, minibosses and minions keep their own colours.
- **Prismarine Shade.** `/slayer+` → World → **Prismarine Shade** (0–100%) darkens placed prismarine, prismarine bricks and dark prismarine, with their stairs, slabs and wall. 0% leaves them as they are, 100% makes them black.

## Downloads
| Your Minecraft version | File |
|---|---|
| 1.21.11 | `solarslayers-0.1.7+1.21.11.jar` |
| 1.21.9 or 1.21.10 | `solarslayers-0.1.7+1.21.9.jar` |
| 26.3 | `solarslayers-0.1.7+26.3.jar` (needs Java 25, like 26.3 itself) |

Replace the old Solar Slayers jar in your mods folder. Needs [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for the same Minecraft version.

Quality-of-life features for slayers on SolarSkies: boss and miniboss highlights, a slayer progress HUD, pity meter, upgrade tracker and quest warnings. Unofficial.
Author: ItzNotNeptune

releases.notes:
Test build, 1.21.11 only.

## New
- **Solar Mob Highlight.** `/slayer+` → Blaze Slayer → **Solar Mob Highlight** colours the normal Solar slayer mobs (blazes and zombified piglins, like Solar Blaze) in a colour you pick. Slayer world only; bosses, minibosses and minions keep their own colours.
- **Pity in Bosses.** `/slayer+` → Slayer HUD → **Pity in Bosses** shows how many bosses are left until your pity drop (e.g. `6 bosses left`) instead of `100/250 (40%)`. It uses the Slayer XP from your last kill, so it shows after one kill with this version.

## Fixed
- **Saved pity XP no longer shows an old amount.** Once you set a pity item, the saved XP goes into it, so the mod forgets the old "XP saved" figure and shows the real one again after your next kill with no pity set.
- **Bosses/hr no longer counts down between bosses.** It's recalculated only when a boss dies and stays the same until the next kill.

## Also in this build (from earlier betas)
- Slayer Timer, saved pity XP, Prismarine Shade.

Download `solarslayers-0.1.7+1.21.11.jar` and replace the old Solar Slayers jar.
